surface: Owner-controlled Management API read_only SELECT; no installed connector
query: select current_user as query_role,current_setting('server_version_num') as server_version_num,current_setting('transaction_read_only') as transaction_read_only,r.rolsuper as installer_superuser,c.name,pc.oid as catalog_oid,pg_get_userbyid(pc.relowner) as owner,has_table_privilege('postgres',c.name,'SELECT') as can_select,has_table_privilege('postgres',c.name,'UPDATE') as table_update,has_any_column_privilege('postgres',c.name,'UPDATE') as any_column_update from (values ('pg_catalog.pg_class'),('pg_catalog.pg_attribute'),('pg_catalog.pg_proc'),('pg_catalog.pg_authid'),('pg_catalog.pg_auth_members'),('pg_catalog.pg_parameter_acl'),('pg_catalog.pg_db_role_setting'),('pg_catalog.pg_event_trigger')) as c(name) join pg_catalog.pg_class pc on pc.oid=to_regclass(c.name) cross join pg_catalog.pg_roles r where r.rolname='postgres' order by c.name
scope: OID and effective table/any-column UPDATE privilege inspection only; no native lock/isolation test or changed design

sourceFindings.serializableCatalogProtection: REL_17_6 PredicateLockingNeededForRelation excludes relation OIDs below FirstUnpinnedObjectId12000; both read/write conflict paths use it. All eight actual K2 catalog OIDs are below12000. Merely changing isolation to SERIALIZABLE cannot be claimed as an authority-catalog conflict barrier.
sourceFindings.rowLockPrivilege: Official PostgreSQL17 SELECT documentation requires UPDATE on at least one column for FOR UPDATE/NO KEY UPDATE/SHARE/KEY SHARE. REL_17_6 analyze.c marks locking clauses ACL_SELECT_FOR_UPDATE. Current K2 readback observes neither table UPDATE nor any-column UPDATE for postgres on eight authority catalogs.
sourceFindings.scopeLimit: Source/privilege inference only; no SQL row-lock or SERIALIZABLE experiment performed. Does not establish every possible SQL solution impossible, provider exclusion capability, accepted maintenance assumption or changed captured authority. Preserve existing2s/10s rules.
